procedure: k_near, k_far = 90th percentile of |RUL - MC mean| / MC sd over test-like validation readings with predicted MC mean <= 50 and > 50; interval = MC mean +/- k x MC sd (lower edge clipped at 0), k picked by the reading's predicted RUL. Re-learned on each dataset's own validation engines.
criterion: coverage closest to 90% on BOTH test-like and near-failure validation readings (leave-engines-out), using only information available at prediction time
evidence: FD001 validation (20 engines), seed-0 LSTM MC passes from Phase 5; no test set used

A.rule: one k from all validation readings (Phase 5)

C.rule: one k from readings with TRUE RUL <= 50 (not usable in deployment as a zone)

E.rule: two k from test-like readings, switched on PREDICTED RUL <= 50
